## param-p01-v01 (1)
supreme / abiding-beyond / from-depth / beginningless / one / entered / manifoldly / in-caves / all-abode / all-moving-unmoving-abiding / to-you / indeed / to-Śambhu / to-refuge / I-resort // param-p01
chunks.l2: I resort to You, Śambhu — supreme, beyond-abiding, beginningless, one, cave-entered manifoldly, abode of all, abiding in all moving and unmoving: to refuge.
chunks.l3:
Supreme, abiding beyond, depthless, beginningless, one,
lodged in many caves, home of all: Śambhu, to You I come for refuge.
chunks.l4:
Supreme, abiding beyond, depthless, beginningless, one —
cave-lodged and manifold, home of all: O Śambhu, to You I come for refuge.

## param-p01-v01 — argument map

Supreme, beyond-abiding, depthless, beginningless, one, cave-entered manifoldly. All-abode, all-moving-unmoving-abiding: to You, Śambhu, to refuge I resort.

Whirled from womb dwelling to death's end on sorrow's wheel,
the student asked the blessed Lord, the prop: the highest truth.
chunks.l4:
Whirled from womb-dwelling to death's end on the sorrow-wheel —
the student asked the blessed Lord, the ground: the supreme truth.

Womb-to-death sorrow-wheel-whirled, the student asked the blessed Lord, the support: the supreme truth.

chunks.l3:
From the weight of his own power's glory, the fourfold egg divided:
power, Māyā, nature, earth, so the Lord displayed.
chunks.l4:
From the weight of his own power's glory, the fourfold egg divided:
power, Māyā, nature, earth — thus the Lord displayed.

By own-power-glory-weight, this egg-fourfold in division. Power, Māyā, nature, earth — thus manifested by the Lord.

chunks.l3:
There within lies the world, a skein of varied bodies, senses, worlds;
and there the enjoyer, embodied, Śiva himself, wearing the beast.

There within lies the world — skein of varied bodies, senses, worlds;
and there the enjoyer, embodied: Śiva himself, wearing the beast.

## param-p01-v05 — argument map

Therein within, this universe: varied body-faculty-world continuum. And therein the enjoyer, embodied: Śiva indeed, fettered-state-taken.

various / of-sorts / form / assumes / as / stainless / crystal / god / man / beast / plant / form-ness / so / Lord / too // param-p01

chunks.l3:
As stainless crystal takes all colors for its own,
so the Lord wears every form, of god and man and beast and plant.
chunks.l4:
As stainless crystal takes all colors for its own —
so the Lord wears every form: god, man, beast, and plant.
chunks.argmap:
## param-p01-v06 — argument map

As stainless crystal assumes various sorts' form, so the Lord too: god-man-beast-plant form-ness.

chunks.l2: As water moves and the moon-disc moves, as water stills so stillness goes: so this self, the great Lord, in the body-faculty-world mass.
chunks.l3:
When waters run, the moon runs; when waters still, stillness:
so this self, great Lord, in the mass of bodies, senses, worlds.
chunks.l4:
When waters run, the moon runs; when waters still, stillness goes —
so this self, great Lord, in the mass of bodies, senses, worlds.
chunks.argmap:
## param-p01-v07 — argument map

As water moves, moves; moon-disc in stillness, stillness goes. So this self, great Lord, in body-faculty-world mass.

chunks.l3:

chunks.l4:

## param-p01-v08 — argument map

As invisible Rahu, moon-disc-abiding, shines, so the all-going self, by object-resorting, in mind-mirror.

chunks.l4:
As a face shines in a stainless mirror —

As in dirt-free mirror face shines, so this self, in Śiva-grace-pure mind-principle, shines light-formed.
